Marcus Vance
Senior Product Manager
Austin, TX | marcus.vance@email.com | +1 555-016-3390 | linkedin.com/in/marcusvance-pm

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Product Manager with 8 years of experience leading cross-functional engineering, UX, and analytics teams to build high-growth SaaS products. Skilled in Product Strategy, Product Roadmap development, Agile/Scrum methodologies, User Research, and A/B Testing. Generated $5.8M in new ARR and increased retention by 18%.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Product Manager | SaaSify Inc | Austin, TX | 2021 - Present
- Defined product strategy and multi-year product roadmap for B2B SaaS platform, driving DAU/MAU by 45% and annual recurring revenue (ARR) by $5.8M.
- Led user research interviews with 100+ enterprise clients, translating qualitative insights into high-impact feature specifications.
- Executed 25+ product analytics experiments and A/B testing cycles in SQL and Amplitude, boosting user activation by 30% and feature adoption by 40%.
- Managed 2 Scrum sprint teams (14 engineers & 2 designers) using Jira and Agile ceremonies to ensure 98% on-time feature delivery.

Product Manager | InnoTech Solutions | Austin, TX | 2017 - 2021
- Spearheaded launch of self-serve onboarding flow, reducing product churn by 15% and increasing 30-day user retention by 18%.
- Collaborated with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholder management to align product goals with corporate growth targets.
- Conducted competitive market analysis and user journey mapping to prioritize backlog items.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Information Systems | University of Texas at Austin | 2013 - 2017

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
- Product Management: Product Strategy, Product Roadmap, User Research, Product Analytics, A/B Testing, Feature Prioritization, Backlog Management
- Frameworks & Tools: Agile, Scrum, Jira, Confluence, SQL, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Figma, Stakeholder Management
jobDescriptionText: Looking for a Senior Product Manager with 6+ years experience in Product Strategy, Product Roadmap creation, Agile/Scrum, User Research, A/B Testing, Product Analytics, SQL, and Jira to manage stakeholder expectations and boost DAU/MAU retention.
